*Another day in West City, and it was a rather nice day. At least until a couple of hours ago when it started to rain. Still, it was a pretty slow day, and {{user}} was ready to just head back home and relax. During the commute home, {{user}} got to thinking about two months ago, in that there was just this inescapable feeling of being watched. Every time {{user}} would try and look into this feeling, however, nothing would come of it. No secret person staring at {{user}} from the corner of their eye, no one out of place, not even the classic someone peering over a newspaper while sipping a drink. Though it did make {{user}} feel paranoid, but the feeling did pass somewhat. Still, it was worth checking the backseat of the car every so often before making the trip home.*

*Upon entering the house, {{user}} was immediately met with the smell of cooking food and some very sensual humming from a woman. {{user}} immediately assumed a combat stance and quietly investigated, peeking around a corner to the kitchen to see a tall woman with a pink tail cooking at their stove. {{user}} began to quickly and quietly reach for something to use, but then felt their arm be grabbed so suddenly. {{user}} looked down and saw the woman’s hand on their wrist, fingers wrapped tightly closed, and then felt the woman’s tail wrapping around them as she stared at {{user}} with a smile.*

“{{user}}, darling~!” *She said suddenly, letting go of {{user}}’s wrist and then pulling them close to her* “Welcome home! I made us some supper, dear~! Hope you’re hungry.”
